Article 1 (Purpose) These guidelines set out the detailed matters needed for the review of graduate degree theses and the conferral of degrees.

blocks.en: Chapter 1 Eligibility and Application for Submitting a Degree Thesis

Article 2 (Eligibility to Submit a Degree Thesis) Under Article 8 of the 「Seoul National University Regulations on the Conferral of Degrees」 (hereinafter the "「Degree Conferral Regulations」"), a person eligible to submit a degree thesis (학위청구논문, a thesis submitted to obtain a degree) must meet the following requirements and must be recommended by the thesis advisor. [Amended 24 Sep 2015 (Thu), 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)]
blocks.ko: 제2조(학위청구논문 제출자격) 「서울대학교 학위수여 규정」(이하 “「학위수여 규정」”이라 한다.) 제8조의 규정에 의 하여 학위청구논문 제출자격은 다음 각 호의 요건을 갖춘 자로서 논문지도교수의 추천을 받은 자이어야 한다. [개 정 2015. 9. 24., 2020. 9. 1.]

blocks.en: 1. A person who has passed the thesis qualifying exams (학위논문제출자격시험: comprehensive exam, English, second foreign language)
2. A person who has earned, or is able to earn by the end of the current semester, the credits required for completion of coursework (수료) set by each college or graduate school
blocks.ko: 2. 각 대학(원)에서 정한 수료에 필요한 학점을 당해학기말까지 취득하였거나 취득가능한 자

blocks.en: 3. A person who has not passed the time limit allowed for submitting a degree thesis (4 years for a master's degree and 6 years for a doctoral degree after completion of coursework)
blocks.ko: 3. 학위 논문제출 허용 기한(과정 수료후 석사 4년, 박사 6년)을 경과하지 않은 자

blocks.en: 4. A person who has received approval for an extension of the thesis submission deadline under Article 11(3) of the 「Degree Conferral Regulations」 [Amended 24 Sep 2015 (Thu), 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)]
blocks.ko: 4. 「학위수여 규정」 제11조제3항에 따라 논문제출기한 연장 승인을 받은 자 [개정 2015. 9. 24., 2020. 9. 1.]

blocks.en: 5. A person who has been given an opportunity to submit a thesis under Article 11(5) of the 「Degree Conferral Regulations」 [Amended 24 Sep 2015 (Thu), 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)]
blocks.ko: 5. 「학위수여 규정」 제11조제5항에 따라 논문제출 기회를 부여받은 자 [개정 2015. 9. 24., 2020. 9. 1.]

blocks.en: 6. A person who has completed graduate coursework and has completed registration as a graduate research student (대학원연구생)

blocks.en: Article 3 (Application and Selection of Review Candidates) ① A person who wishes to have a degree thesis (or a review of achievements) reviewed must pay the prescribed review fee each semester and, within the designated period and with the approval of the thesis advisor, submit the following documents to the dean of the college or graduate school through the chair of the department (or school).

blocks.en: Article 9 (Chair of the Review Committee) ① The chair of the review committee is elected by and from among the thesis review committee members (호선). ② The thesis advisor, emeritus professors, and experts from outside SNU cannot be the chair. ③ In decisions, the chair has the same authority as the other committee members. ④ The chair leads the thesis review and must submit the review result, together with the review summary, to the dean of the college or graduate school through the chair of the department (or school) within the prescribed period.
blocks.ko: 제9조(심사위원장) ① 심사위원장은 논문심사 위원 중에서 호선한다. ② 논문지도교수, 명예교수 및 교외전문가는 심사위원장이 될 수 없다. ③ 심사위원장은 의결에 있어 기타 심사위원과 동일한 권한을 가진다. ④ 심사위원장은 논문심사의 진행을 주관하고, 심사결과를 심사요지와 함께 소정 기일 내에 학과(부)장을 경유하 여 소속 대학(원)장에게 제출하여야 한다.

blocks.en: Chapter 4 Thesis Review and Evaluation Methods, etc.

Article 10 (Thesis Summary Presentation, Preliminary Review, and Main Review) ① The head of each college or graduate school must hold at least 1 thesis summary presentation for thesis submitters, under the responsibility of the chair of each department (or school) or the chair of the review committee. ② The preliminary review of the thesis is held only for doctoral thesis submitters, at least 2 times, under the responsibility of the chair of each department (or school) or the chair of the review committee. ③ In the preliminary review, the review committee members examine the submitter's research attitude, the validity of the thesis topic, the validity of the methods, the research results, etc., and judge whether the thesis can be completed within the current semester. ④ The main review of the thesis is held within the period set by the dean of each college or graduate school, under the responsibility of the chair of the review committee. ⑤ In the main review, the committee checks whether the issues pointed out in the preliminary review have been addressed and judges whether the thesis has any defects in content or structure as a degree thesis. ⑥ Under Article 23 of the Degree Conferral Regulations, when the review committee members consider it necessary for the review, they may require the thesis submitter to submit reference papers, or duplicates, translations, models, specimens and other materials.
blocks.ko: 제10조(논문요지 발표, 예비심사 및 본심사) ① 각 대학(원)의 장은 학위논문 제출자에 대하여 각 학과(부)장 또는 심 사위원장의 책임 하에 논문요지 발표회를 1회 이상 실시하여야 한다. ② 학위논문의 예비심사는 박사과정의 학위논문 제출자에 한하여 각 학과(부)장 또는 심사위원장의 책임 하에 2회 이상 실시하여야 한다. ③ 논문심사위원은 논문 예비심사에 있어서 학위논문 제출자의 연구태도, 논문주제의 타당성, 취급방법의 타당성 , 연구 성과 등을 심사하여 당해 학기 내에 완성 가능성을 판정한다. ④ 학위논문의 본 심사는 각 대학(원)장이 정한 소정의 기일 내에 심사위원장의 책임 하에 실시한다. ⑤ 학위논문 본 심사에서는 논문의 예비심사에서 지적된 사항의 보완이 이루어졌는가를 검토하고 내용과 체계상 으로 학위논문으로서의 결함이 있는가를 판정한다. ⑥ 학위수여규정 제23조의 규정에 의하여 심사위원은 심사에 필요하다고 인정할 때에는 학위논문 제출자에게 참고논문 또는 부본·역본·모형·표본 및 기타 자료를 제출하게 할 수 있다.

blocks.en: Article 11 (Evaluation Methods for Thesis Review and Oral Examination) ① A master's thesis is evaluated as "A (approved by all committee members)", "B (approved by 2/3 of committee members)", or "C (approved by 1/3 or fewer of committee members)"; to pass the thesis review, the thesis grade must be "B" or higher. ② To pass a doctoral thesis review, approval by 4/5 or more of the review committee members is required. ③ The oral examination is held at the final thesis review. The passing score, out of 100 points, is an average of 60 points or more for the master's program and an average of 70 points or more for the doctoral program (4/5 or more of the committee members must give 70 points or more). ④ The chair of the review committee must submit the review result to the dean of the college or graduate school within the prescribed period. ⑤ The head of each college or graduate school must, after deliberation by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee, report the final review results to the Graduate School Council by the end of July for the 1st semester and by the end of January for the 2nd semester. However, the Graduate School of Business must report to the Graduate School Council within 10 days after the review ends each semester, according to its own academic calendar.
blocks.ko: 제11조(논문심사 및 구술고사 평가방법) ① 석사학위 논문은 “A(심사위원 전원 찬성)”, “B(심사위원 2/3 찬성)”, “C(심 사위원 1/3이하 찬성)”으로 평가하되, 논문심사 합격은 논문성적 “B” 이상이어야 한다. ② 박사학위 논문심사 합격은 심사위원 5분의 4이상의 찬성을 받아야 한다. ③ 구술고사는 논문의 최종심사시에 시행하며, 합격점수는 100점 만점에 석사과정은 평균 60점이상, 박사과정은 평균 70점이상(심사위원 4/5이상이 70점 이상이어야 함)이어야 한다. ④ 심사위원장은 심사결과를 소정 기일 내에 대학(원)장에게 제출하여야 한다. ⑤ 각 대학(원)의 장은 최종 심사결과를 대학원학사위원회의 심의를 거쳐 1학기는 7월말, 2학기는 1월말까지 대 학원위원회에 보고하여야 한다. 다만 경영전문대학원은 자체 학사일정에 따라 매학기 심사 종료 후 10일이내에 대학원위원회에 보고하여야 한다.

blocks.en: Chapter 5 Submission and Publication of Degree Theses

Article 15 (Submission of Degree Theses and Handling of Non-submitters) ① A person who has passed the thesis review (hereinafter "a person who passed the thesis review") must, under the guidance of the thesis advisor, faithfully make the revisions required in the review and write the final version of the thesis. ② The writing method, size and format of the thesis follow separate rules. ③ Under Article 89 (Graduation from Graduate Programs) of the University Rules (학칙), a person who passed the thesis review must submit the electronic file of the final certified thesis, with the approval page (인준지) signed or sealed (날인, seal or signature) by all review committee members, to the place set by the dean of each college or graduate school within the prescribed period of the current semester. [Amended 24 Sep 2015 (Thu), 2 Dec 2020 (Wed)] ④ Despite Paragraph 3, the dean of each college or graduate school may extend the thesis submission deadline by 1 semester if there is a justified reason. In this case, the person who received the extension is awarded the degree in the semester in which the thesis is submitted. ⑤ A person whose degree conferral has been postponed does not need to submit the review candidate registration documents for the next semester. ⑥ The head of each college or graduate school must report the results of handling under Paragraphs 3 and 4 to the Graduate School Council within the prescribed period each semester. ⑦ The thesis submitted under Paragraph 3 may be replaced, only when the submitter's academic record changes due to a change of name, upon confirmation by the advisor and a request from the dean of the college or graduate school to the Director of the Central Library; when there are obvious typos or editing errors, an errata sheet (정오표, list of corrections) may additionally be submitted within the prescribed period. [Newly inserted 5 Jan 2021 (Tue)] ⑧ The head of each college or graduate school may require persons who passed the thesis review to submit a separate copy of the thesis for its own records.
blocks.ko: 제15조(학위논문 제출 및 미제출자 처리) ① 학위논문 심사에서 합격 받은 자(이하 “학위논문심사 합격자”라 한다)는 논문지도교수의 지도하에 심사에서 수정 보완된 내용을 충실히 이행하여 논문을 최종적으로 작성하여야 한다. ② 학위논문의 작성방법, 규격 및 형식은 따로 정한 바에 따른다. ③ 학칙 제89조(대학원과정의 졸업)의 규정에 의하여 학위논문심사 합격자는 심사위원 전원이 인준지에 서명 또 는 날인한 최종 인증된 학위논문의 전자파일을 당해학기 소정의 기간 내에 각 대학(원)장이 정하는 장소에 제출 하여야 한다. [개정 2015. 9. 24., 2020. 12. 2.] ④ 제3항의 규정에 불구하고 각 대학(원)장은 정당한 사유가 있다고 인정하는 경우 학위논문 제출기한을 1개 학 기 연장할 수 있다. 이 경우 연장된 자에게는 학위 논문을 제출한 학기에 학위를 수여한다. ⑤ 학위수여대상에서 유보된 자의 다음 학기 논문심사대상자 등록서류 제출은 생략한다. ⑥ 각 대학(원)의 장은 제3항 및 제4항의 처리결과를 매학기 소정 기일 내에 대학원위원회에 보고하여야 한다. ⑦ 제3항의 제출논문은 개명으로 인해 논문 제출자의 학적이 변경되는 경우에 한하여 지도교수의 확인을 거쳐 대학(원)장이 중앙도서관장에게 요청하여 교체할 수 있으며, 명백한 오탈자, 편집상의 오류가 있는 경우에는 소정 기한 내 정오표를 추가로 제출할 수 있다. [신설 2021. 1. 5.] ⑧ 각 대학(원)의 장은 자체 보관용으로 학위논문 심사 합격자에게 별도의 학위논문을 제출하도록 할 수 있다.

blocks.en: Article 16 (Publication of Degree Theses) ① Under Article 27 of the 「Degree Conferral Regulations」, a person who has received a doctoral degree must publish the doctoral thesis within 1 year after obtaining the degree, by publishing a book, publishing in an academic society journal, a periodical or an international academic journal, presenting at an academic seminar, or by other methods. [Amended 24 Sep 2015 (Thu), 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)] ② Despite Paragraph 1, if the degree holder applies for postponement of thesis publication due to a planned patent application, military secrecy, or other unavoidable reasons, the dean of each college or graduate school may, after deliberation by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee, postpone publication for up to 3 years. [Amended 14 May 2009 (Thu)] ③ If a degree holder whose thesis publication was postponed under Paragraph 2 applies for a further postponement, the dean of each college or graduate school may, after deliberation by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee, extend the postponement period by up to 2 years. [Amended 14 May 2009 (Thu)] ④ If there are persons whose publication is postponed under Paragraphs 2 and 3, the head of each college or graduate school must notify the Director of the Central Library of the result. [Amended 14 May 2009 (Thu)]
blocks.ko: 제16조(학위논문의 공표) ① 「학위수여 규정」 제27조에 따라 박사학위를 받은 자는 학위취득 후 1년 이내에 단행본 발간, 학회지 게재, 정기간행물 게재, 국제학술지 게재, 학술세미나에서 발표, 기타의 방법으로 박사학위 논문을 공 표하여야 한다. [개정 2015. 9. 24., 2020. 9. 1.] ② 제1항의 규정에 불구하고 학위취득자가 특허출원예정, 군사상 비밀, 기타 부득이한 사유 등으로 학위논문 공 표유보를 신청한 경우 각 대학(원)장은 대학원학사위원회의 심의를 거쳐 3년 이내에서 공표를 유보할 수 있다. [개정 2009. 5. 14.] ③ 제2항의 규정에 의거 학위논문 공표 유보를 받은 학위취득자가 추가로 공표유보를 신청한 경우 각 대학(원)장 은 대학원학사위원회의 심의를 거쳐 2년 이내에서 공표 유보기간을 연장할 수 있다. [개정 2009. 5. 14.] ④ 각 대학(원)의 장은 제2항 및 제3항의 공표유보 대상자가 있는 경우 그 결과를 중앙도서관장에게 통보하여야 한다. [개정 2009. 5. 14.]

Article 17 (Conferral of a Degree of a Different Type from the Department's Degree) ① Under Article 2(2) of the 「Degree Conferral Regulations」, a dean of a college or graduate school who wishes to confer a degree of a different type from that of the relevant department must obtain approval from the Graduate School Council after consultation between departments within the college or graduate school, or between colleges or graduate schools. [Amended 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)] ② A person who wishes to receive a degree of a different type from that of the relevant department must submit an application for change of degree type to the dean of the college or graduate school at the time review committee members are appointed each semester. blocks.ko: 제17조(해당학과 학위와 다른 종별 학위수여) ① 「학위수여 규정」 제2조제2항에 따라 해당학과와 다른 종별의 학위 를 수여하고자 하는 대학(원)장은 대학(원) 내 학과간 또는 대학(원)간 협의를 거친 후 대학원위원회의 승인을 받 아야 한다.[개정 2020. 9. 1.] ② 해당학과와 다른 종별의 학위를 받고자 하는 자는 매학기 논문심사위원 위촉시 학위종별변경신청서를 소속 대학(원)장에게 제출하여야 한다. Article 18 (Handling of Persons Who Passed the Thesis Review but Do Not Meet Completion Requirements, etc.) ① Among those who passed the thesis review, a person who does not meet Article 78 (Credits for Program Completion, etc.) and Article 83 (Recognition of Earned Credits) of the 「Seoul National University Rules」 and other separate criteria set by each college or graduate school is considered to be excluded from degree conferral. [Amended 24 Sep 2015 (Thu), 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)] ② For a person excluded from degree conferral under Paragraph 1, the head of each college or graduate school withdraws the relevant thesis review result and has the person go through the prescribed procedure again in the next semester. ③ The head of each college or graduate school must report the results of handling under Paragraph 2 to the President within the prescribed period each semester.
blocks.ko: 제18조(논문심사 합격자중 수료요건 등 미충족자 처리) ① 논문심사 합격자중 「서울대학교 학칙」 제78조(과정이수 학점 등), 제83조(취득학점의 인정) 및 기타 각 대학(원)에서 정한 별도의 기준을 충족하지 못한 자는 학위수여대 상 탈락자로 간주한다. [개정 2015. 9. 24., 2020. 9. 1.] ② 각 대학(원)의 장은 제1항의 학위수여 탈락자에 대하여 해당 논문심사결과를 철회조치하고, 다음 학기에 소정 의 절차를 다시 취하도록 한다. ③ 각 대학(원)의 장은 제2항의 처리 결과를 매학기 소정 기간 내에 총장에게 보고하여야 한다.

blocks.en: Article 19 (Revocation of Degrees) ① If a person received a degree by dishonest means, or if there was a serious defect in the process of obtaining the degree, the conferral of the degree may be revoked. ② If there is a person subject to revocation under Paragraph 1, the head of each college or graduate school must propose this to the President after deliberation by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee. ③ The President revokes the degree with the approval of 2/3 or more of the members present at the Graduate School Council.
blocks.ko: 제19조(학위의 취소) ① 학위를 받은 자가 당해 학위를 부정한 방법으로 받은 경우 또는 학위취득 과정에서 중대한 하자가 있는 경우에는 학위수여를 취소할 수 있다. ② 제1항의 학위수여 취소 대상자가 있는 경우 각 대학(원)의 장은 대학원학사위원회의 심의를 거쳐 총장에게 제 의하여야 한다. ③ 총장은 대학원위원회의 출석의원 3분의 2이상의 찬성을 얻어 학위수여를 취소한다.

blocks.en: Article 20 (Collection of Thesis Review Fees and Payment of Allowances) ① Under Article 45 of the 「Enforcement Decree of the Higher Education Act」, a thesis review fee is collected from thesis review candidates in order to pay a review allowance to the thesis review committee members. [Amended 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)] ② The amount collected per person and the amount paid are as shown in Appendix Table 2. ③ The review allowance is paid when the thesis review is completed and the review summary and the review result report have been submitted. ④ The dean of each college or graduate school may additionally pay external experts on the review committee a fixed amount by region as travel expenses, in addition to the review allowance, within the budget of the university corporation accounts (법인회계). [Amended 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)]
blocks.ko: 제20조(논문심사료 징수 및 수당 지급) ① 「고등교육법 시행령」 제45조에 따라 학위논문 심사위원에게 논문심사 수 당을 지급하고자 논문심사 대상자에게 논문심사료를 징수한다. [개정 2020. 9. 1.] ② 논문심사료의 1인당 징수액 및 지급액은 별표 2와 같다. ③ 논문심사 수당은 학위 논문심사를 마치고 심사요지서와 심사결과 보고서를 제출하였을 때에 지급한다. ④ 각 대학(원)장은 논문심사위원 중 교외전문가에 대하여 논문심사 수당이외에 지역별로 일정금액을 여비명목 으로 법인회계 예산의 범위 내에서 추가로 지급할 수 있다. [개정 2020. 9. 1.]

blocks.en: Article 21 (Refund of Thesis Review Fees) ① If a thesis review candidate, after paying the review fee, requests withdrawal because the review cannot proceed for unavoidable reasons, the head of each college or graduate school may refund the review fee, only before the review committee members are appointed. [Amended 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)] ② When there is a person eligible for a refund under Paragraph 1, the head of each college or graduate school must request the refund from the Academic Affairs Division (교무과). [Amended 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)]
blocks.ko: 제21조(논문심사료 환불) ① 논문심사대상자가 논문심사료 납부 후 부득이 논문심사진행이 어려워 철회를 요청한 경우 각 대학(원)의 장은 논문심사위원 위촉 전에 한하여 논문심사료를 환불하여 줄 수 있다. [개정 2020. 9. 1.] ② 제1항의 환불대상자가 발생할 경우 각 대학(원)의 장은 교무과로 환불을 요청하여야 한다. [개정 2020. 9. 1.]

blocks.en: Article 22 (Exemption from Thesis Review Fees) ① Under Article 12(1), doctoral thesis review candidates who received approval for an extension of the review period in the previous semester are exempt from the review fee. However, if review committee members are replaced, the review allowance for the newly selected members may be paid at each college's or graduate school's discretion within the corporation accounts budget allocated to it. [Amended 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)] ② A person whose thesis submission deadline was extended by 1 semester under Article 15(4) is exempt from the review fee for the next semester. [Amended 1 Sep 2020 (Tue)] ③ Master's students of the Graduate School of Business, the Graduate School of International Studies (Department of International Development Policy) and the Graduate School of Medicine are exempt from the review fee. However, as determined by the dean of the graduate school concerned, a fixed review allowance may be paid to review committee members from its own budget. [Amended 2 Dec 2009 (Wed), 31 Mar 2011 (Thu)]
blocks.ko: 제22조(논문심사료 징수 면제) ① 제12조제1항에 따라 박사학위 논문심사 대상자중 직전학기에 심사연장승인을 받 은 자는 논문심사료 징수를 면제한다. 다만 심사위원 교체시 새로이 선정된 심사위원의 논문심사 수당은 각 대학 (원)에 배정된 법인회계 예산범위 내에서 자율적으로 지급할 수 있다. [개정 2020. 9. 1.] ② 제15조제4항에 따라 학위논문 제출기한을 1개 학기 연장받은 자는 다음 학기 논문심사료 징수를 면제한다. [개정 2020. 9. 1.] ③ 경영전문대학원, 국제대학원(국제개발정책학과) 및 의학대학원 석사과정 학생들에게는 논문심사료 징수를 면 제한다. 다만, 소속 대학원장이 정하는 바에 따라 자체 예산으로 논문심사위원들에게 일정금액의 논문심사 수당 을 지급할 수 있다. [개정 2009. 12. 2., 2011. 3. 31.]

- Students taking the 논자시 (thesis qualifying exam) in the 1st semester of 2026 should apply for now. If they are judged to have failed the 논자시, they must contact the staff member at the Department Administration Office to cancel the application.

- Even if you passed the major exam, you cannot print the fee notice if you failed the foreign language exam. (You can check this in 마이스누 (mySNU) > 학사정보 (Academic Information) > 졸업 (Graduation) > 졸업시험 신청 (Graduation Exam Application) > 종합시험 판정결과 조회 (Comprehensive Exam Results)].)

- Since the 1st semester of the 2006 academic year, the English part of the 논자시 foreign language exam has been replaced by a qualification recognition system. Students who must meet this requirement (those who have not yet been recognised as passed) must obtain a TEPS or TOEFL score at or above the minimum score set by the College of Engineering, and must submit that score to the Department Administration Office before submitting the thesis review documents (early March or early September each semester).
2) Meet the 수료 (course completion) requirements
- The SNU course completion simulator system does not include the department's internal rules, so its results are not accurate.
Therefore, you must read the [자주 묻는 질문 (FAQ)] post — the course completion self-check list — and the Academic Guide, and check whether you have completed the course requirements.

- If you do not meet the course completion requirements, you cannot graduate, regardless of whether you pass the thesis review. You must check whether you meet the requirements using the course completion self-check list before the review.
3) Meet the requirements for awarding the degree (research output)
* See the post on the rules that change from the 2nd semester of 2026: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57606

Only papers or patents that include the advisor's name as a co-author, and in which the degree candidate's name is listed first among the authors excluding the advisor, are recognised.
Both (1) and (2) below must be met.
(1) At least 1 paper must be published, or confirmed for publication, in an internationally recognised journal (SCI(E) level).
(2) There must be at least 1 paper presented at an international conference, or 1 paper published in a domestic journal, or 1 registered international patent.
